title: Partial Approval is not modelled
detail: ATL105 10.1.2 lists Partial Approval as a supported credit transaction (POS Purchase, POS and CAT Authorization Only; Element 121 = 1 -> Response Code F with Approved Amount, reversal = approved amount, TOR = requested amount). Dev has no scenario, flow or rule for it. Trained FR-006: 0/4 BRs covered.
references: ATL105 10.1.2 p.83, 10.1.2.1 p.84; SPEC-TXN-11, SPEC-FLOW-09; trained TS-026, TS-027, CTX-BR-MASTERCARD-CREDIT-CREDIT-PARTIAL
affected: BR1_TS1, BR1_TS2, BR1_TS3, BR1_TS4, BR1_TS5, BR1_TS6, BR1_TS7, BR1_TS8, BR1_TS11, BR1_TS12, BR1_TS13, BR1_TS14 (+4 more)
recommendation: Add Partial Approval scenarios for POS Purchase (0), POS Authorization Only (3) and CAT Authorization Only (5), including the partially approved reversal and TOR amount rules.

title: Authorization Only Reversal (Cancellation S) does not carry the Approval Number
detail: Section 10.1.2.2 requires Element 5 (Approval Number) and Element 86 (Sequence Number) from the original authorization to be present and identical; Dev carries only the Sequence Number. The trained Approval Number capture/retention scenarios (TS-022, TS-023) are therefore NOT_COVERED.
references: ATL105 10.1.2.2 p.85; SPEC-FLOW-02; trained TS-022, TS-023, CTX-BR-MASTERCARD-CREDIT-FLOW-AUTH_CANCELLATION
affected: BR1_TS53, BR1_TS54, BR1_TS55, BR1_TS56, BR1_TS57, BR1_TS58, BR1_TS59, BR1_TS60
recommendation: Add the Approval Number carry to every Cancellation leg and name the category 'Authorization Only Reversal (Cancellation, S)'.

title: BR claims ATL105 2026-4 but its carried-field rule IDs use 2026-3 pages
detail: 5 rule IDs (BR-402-1, BR-402-3, BR-38-9, BR-38-4, BR-97-7; 82 uses) resolve only on 2026-3 pages (e.g. BR-402-* = 2026-3 p.402 Element 86; 2026-4 p.402 is Element 80). BR-97-7 is taken from the debit section (2026-3 p.97). The 14/14 business sections compared are textually identical in both versions, so content is unaffected, but the storage policy blocks CONFIRMED coverage until citations are corrected.
references: ARTIFACT-STORAGE-POLICY.md (AI run intake rule 6); version check table
affected: BR1_TS1, BR1_TS2, BR1_TS3, BR1_TS4, BR1_TS5, BR1_TS6, BR1_TS7, BR1_TS8, BR1_TS29, BR1_TS30, BR1_TS31, BR1_TS32 (+50 more)
recommendation: Rebuild the Dev knowledge base on 2026-4 or cite the 2026-3 pages explicitly; re-issue rule IDs.

title: The 785 supporting rules are delivered as counts only
detail: Each scenario lists a rule count (141-460) but no rule IDs, anchors or text. 72 trained business scenarios and 108 trained BRs fall in a Dev context without any stated requirement, so field-level coverage (Segment 100/111/130/131, amounts, responses) cannot be verified.
recommendation: Deliver the per-scenario rule list (rule ID, ATL105 section/page/element, statement) so it can be cross-walked to the 601-rule Test Solution catalogue.

title: Mastercard-specific requirements are absent
detail: No Dev scenario or rule expresses: MasterCard Preauthorization vs Final Authorization presentment (auth/completion/auth cancellation vs sale/reversal/return/void) (Appendix G p.545); MasterCard stored credentials: MIT/CIT category and subcategory (Appendix Z p.713); MasterCard Token / Digital Secure Remote Payment requires Segment 123 (12.19 p.267); MasterCard UCAF / Identity Check (3-D Secure) data (Appendix I (Table 036) p.581); MasterCard Transaction Link Identifier retained from the original response and sent on subsequent transactions (Appendix I p.627); MasterCard Merchant Advice Code in responses (Appendix K p.663); MasterCard Enhanced Fleet EMV: Purchase Restriction Method mandatory on authorization/pre-authorization and completion (Appendix I p.595); Estimated and Incremental Authorization (Visa, Mastercard, Amex) (Appendix AF p.730); Real-Time Account Updater (Visa and MasterCard) (12.39 p.314); MasterCard Purchase Repayment (value 'IR') (Appendix I p.590); Mastercard QR (Pay by Link, X QR) (Appendix I p.624); MasterCard EMV PIN mandate: devices supporting EMV PIN must support online and offline PIN (10.14.3 p.162); Terminal PIN-entry capability (position 3), incl. code 3 only for MasterCard mobile POS (mPOS) (Appendix J-2 p.639).
references: SPEC-EMV-11, SPEC-ENTRY-16, SPEC-MC-01, SPEC-MC-02, SPEC-MC-03, SPEC-MC-04, SPEC-MC-05, SPEC-MC-06, SPEC-MC-08, SPEC-MC-09, SPEC-MC-10, SPEC-MC-11, SPEC-MC-12
recommendation: Add Mastercard-specific BRs/scenarios (stored credential MIT/CIT, token/DSRP, UCAF/3DS, incremental authorization, preauthorization vs final presentment, Transaction Link ID, EMV PIN, mPOS, Fleet EMV data).

title: MasterCard Fleet Credential on File scenarios conflict with Appendix J note 2
detail: Entry Mode 10 is applicable to Visa Credit, MasterCard Credit, Discover Credit and Amex; MasterCard Fleet is not listed, yet Dev keeps Fleet Credential on File scenarios (unconfirmed).
recommendation: Exclude Fleet x Credential on File or obtain an SME/PIPS decision.

title: Section 10.1 credit processing requirements are not modelled
detail: Device validates the expiration date on credit transactions [CONTEXT_ONLY]; Address Verification Service (AVS) [NOT_COVERED]; Bill payment / recurring / installment transactions (Segment 111 indicator) [NOT_COVERED]; Healthcare auto-substantiation (FSA/HRA) for MasterCard [NOT_COVERED]; Credit receipt requirements, incl. MasterCard Card Type ID 'MC' [NOT_COVERED]; Regulatory data-storage restrictions for MasterCard and MasterCard Fleet [NOT_COVERED].
references: SPEC-CR-01, SPEC-CR-04, SPEC-CR-05, SPEC-CR-07, SPEC-CR-08, SPEC-CR-09
recommendation: Add AVS, bill-payment/recurring/installment, healthcare (FSA/HRA), receipt and data-storage requirements where in scope, or record an explicit scope exclusion.

title: Mail/Phone lifecycle flows are incomplete
detail: Mail/Phone Purchase (6) -> Mail/Phone Reversal (C): 2 variant(s) in 2 scenario(s); gap: flow_gap: no flow template for MOTO_REVERSAL (non_emv) in config/business_model.json; leg 2 message and carry links are not known; Sequence Number not carried in 2 scenario(s); Time-out Reversal of a Mail/Phone Purchase: 2 variant(s) in 2 scenario(s); gap: FLOW_CODE_MISMATCH: FLOW-TIMEOUT-REVERSAL step 1 fixes Transaction Type '0', not a code of Mail/Phone Purchase
references: ATL105 2.3 p.39, Appendix G p.546; SPEC-FLOW-04, SPEC-FLOW-07
recommendation: Add the MOTO_REVERSAL flow template (leg-2 message and carried fields) and a TOR template whose original leg accepts Transaction Type 6.

title: Time-out handling and queued TOR ordering are not modelled
detail: Dev models original -> TOR only. The 30-second response interval, late-response handling and the rule that a queued TOR precedes the next financial request from the same device are absent.
references: ATL105 2.3.1 p.40; SPEC-FLOW-08, SPEC-FLOW-10; trained TS-028, TS-029, TS-032, CTX TOR-ORDER, TIMEOUT_TOR_NEXT
affected: BR1_TS45, BR1_TS46, BR1_TS47, BR1_TS48, BR1_TS49, BR1_TS50, BR1_TS51, BR1_TS52, BR1_TS101, BR1_TS102, BR1_TS103, BR1_TS104 (+4 more)

title: MasterCard Fleet scope rests on a source that is not in the repository
detail: ATL105 10.6 delegates fleet processing to the Petroleum Industry Processing Specifications. All 40 Fleet scenarios, 82 Fleet exclusions and 7 citations rely on SRC-BUYPASS-PIPS-PDF-001 pp.31-53, which cannot be verified here.
